purpose: Controlled clean-HEAD versus unstaged-M2b SQLite busy-time diagnosis
head: c8fe029b8c3bd3a6a8197cd9ad4ae8441c4fff16

correspondence.candidate: clean HEAD plus all ten unstaged M2b candidate paths as recorded before this diagnosis

contract.sqliteContract: https://sqlite.org/c3ref/busy_timeout.html: accumulated sleep reaches at least the configured milliseconds; no hard wall-clock upper bound is promised

instrumentedPublicApiProbe.description: The probe recreates the public fixture/write sequence and times native DatabaseSync calls without changing store or test files.
instrumentedPublicApiProbe.result: Every BEGIN IMMEDIATE threw ERR_SQLITE_ERROR database is locked. PRAGMA setup, readback, identity checks and close were individually below one millisecond in the first probe pair; the long operation was BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

classification.observedCause: The wall-clock upper-bound assertion is exceeded inside native DatabaseSync BEGIN IMMEDIATE while another connection holds a reserved write lock, even though busy_timeout reads back as 5000 ms. SQLite specifies a minimum accumulated sleep before SQLITE_BUSY, not a hard wall-clock maximum.
classification.unresolvedLowerLevelCause: The comparison does not establish why the native SQLite busy wait exceeds its configured value on this host. Scheduler/load interaction and Node/SQLite busy-handler behavior remain hypotheses.
classification.qualification: M2b-specific gates pass, but full qualification remains blocked until a complete prescribed suite passes.
